name: Mail Desk
description: A focused read-only composed desk over the local index: search, browse and read plain-text, with deep links. Index-only - no attachments or rich mail HTML, no browser plugin code, nothing moved or sent.

tools.name: search_messages
tools.description: Search the local mail index by sender, subject or snippet. Returns a capped result list.

tools.name: read_message
tools.description: Read one indexed message by id (headers, category, tags, plain text).

pages.title: Mail Desk
pages.description: Search and read the local mail index
